description: The end plug's parent turns 200 about X, which the swing-twist split reads as -160, and the secondary twist stays 0, so the end's total twist is the plain wrapped angle -160 and the ramp runs 0 to -160: -40 at u = 0.25, -80 at u = 0.5 and -120 at u = 0.75. The same limit as the end control's own roll (end_twist_200_without_the_secondary).
